content.rationale: IN-mechanism (lmomkluy) fixes the ordered bootstrap — create the git repository, append the state directory to `.git/info/exclude`, then create the jj workspace colocated with it — and this is that sequence as one module. The state directory is recorded once, so git's own template is recorded without being clobbered and a re-run adds nothing. Both crossings run through the one runner (M-jj) under caller-supplied binaries; the git binary is resolved by the caller the way it resolves jj, and `.git/info/exclude` is read and appended through the exclude module (M-exclude, nrvtvmln) on the target, never std::fs. M-layout places the module flat at src/jj_init.rs. It returns failures as values and renders nothing. The record step is idempotent (IN-record-idempotent, vnsyvzpp): the module reads the file and appends the entry only when it is not already a line, so a re-run adds nothing. An exclude failure is refused at this step (S2-exclude-refusal-site, yuslrlov) — the invocation that touches the file produces the refusal, the envelope renders it.
